unresolved_data_companion.article_title_on_data_record: Accurate Synchronization-Free UWB-TDoA Indoor Localization with Unlimited Tag Support
unresolved_data_companion.evidence: Zenodo and Universitat de València index document the dataset. Exact-title Crossref search returned different studies. DataCite title lookup returned dataset version and concept only. No standalone article with confirmed identifier or usable full text was found. Earlier Pérez-Solano et al. is catalogued as a nearby publication only.

scope: R5 physical relative localization and time synchronization, source/destination or passive timestamps, packet sequence identifiers, and control delivery/application/response timing. Checked seven dedicated follow-ups and 55 earlier continuous rounds.

dedup: Compared DOI, arXiv, title/version aliases, normalized titles and first-author close titles against all tracked project evidence text, bibliographies, citation lists and the early catalogue. Any prior mention of a DOI in project evidence counts as historical.
family_handling: MILUV and UTIL are different acquisitions; multi-robot pose-estimation papers using related platforms do not automatically supply separate released files.
WSR journal article and 2012.04174 form one record. WSR toolbox conference publication and 2109.12205 form another, with the Sensor/Framework title variants explicitly joined.

The 2019 feedback-control conference paper (1804.08986), mode-change demo and expanded journal article (1909.10873) are distinct publications in one experimental family. NCSbench main article, demonstration and earlier platform paper have independent bibliographic identifiers but share a platform.
excluded_candidate_rules: Collapsed duplicate preprints and excluded unrelated radar, underwater localization, human-motion and navigation-only hits; retained secondary studies and demo records where they locate a measurement or distinct publication.
For a directed citation, verified a deposited reference, indexed referenced_works relation or the full-text reference. An incoming search hit by itself is insufficient.
limitations: Purposive public search. Rate-limited queries are recorded. A time-of-flight exchange, a clock map, a physical-state measurement and a controller application event characterize different parts of a system. Only the indexed source versions have been screened, and no article or external raw data are redistributed in these tables.

supplemental_history_check.method: Every other tracked file, including source code, XML, manifests, gzip files and tar members, was also scanned for the normalized DOI and case-folded arXiv, title, and title/version aliases of each retained record. Screening metadata in the historical import was additionally checked for normalized titles and authors via the baseline catalogue.
